description: This file defines an 'ApprovalService' class for managing submission approvals in a workflow system, including e-signature challenges, signature verification, approval/rejection processes with segregation of duties checks, state management, and evidence handling. It also includes custom exception classes related to approval errors.

classes.name: ApprovalError
classes.description: Base exception class for approval-related errors.

classes.name: SoDViolationError
classes.description: Raised when a Segregation of Duties violation occurs.

classes.name: SignatureError
classes.description: Indicates failure in electronic signature validation.

classes.name: InvalidStateError
classes.description: Raised when an invalid state transition is attempted.

classes.name: ApprovalService
classes.description: Main service class providing approval workflow management, including e-sign challenges, signature verification, approval/rejection, audit logging, and evidence handling.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_esign_challenge( self, user_id: str, intent: str, correlation_id: str )
methods.description: Creates an electronic signature challenge for a user, including challenge ID, data, and expiration time.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] verify_esign( self, user_id: str, password: str, intent: str, signature_block: Dict[str, Any], correlation_id: str )
methods.description: Verifies a user's electronic signature, generating a signature hash and timestamp.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] approve_submission( self, submission_id: str, decision: str, approver_user_id: str, approver_role: str, signature: Dict[str, Any], correlation_id: str, required_preconditions: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, rationale: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Handles approval or rejection of a submission, with SoD checks, signature validation, state updates, audit, and evidence creation.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_approval_record(self, approval_record_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an approval record by ID, including signature details.

methods.name: list list_approval_records(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all approval records for a given submission.
